CFML Language Reference: Functions

ValueList

Returns the values of one column, for every row of a query, as a delimited list.

Category

Query functions

Syntax

ValueList(query.column [, delimiter ])

Parameters

query.column
A column reference written literally as query name, dot, column name. It cannot be a string or a variable that holds the name.
delimiter
String placed between the values. The default is a comma.

Returns

The list as a string. An empty query returns an empty string.

Usage

A classic use is to feed the result of one query into the WHERE clause of another: WHERE Dept_ID IN (#ValueList(GetDepts.Dept_ID)#). That works for numeric columns; for text columns use QuotedValueList.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetSales" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT FirstName, LastName
FROM Employees
WHERE Department = 'Sales'
ORDER BY LastName
</CFQUERY>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Sales staff (#GetSales.RecordCount#): #ValueList(GetSales.LastName, ", ")#</P>
<P>As a list, ListLen = #ListLen(ValueList(GetSales.LastName))#
and the first one is #ListFirst(ValueList(GetSales.LastName))#.</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

QuotedValueList, ArrayToList, ListLen, CFQUERY
